question:
Select the correct option:

He completed the assignment ahead of time, ___ impressed the supervisor.
solution:
The correct answer is '**which**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 

• The word "**which**" is a relative pronoun that introduces a clause providing additional information about the preceding statement. 

• In the given sentence, "**which**" connects the completion of the assignment ahead of time with the action of impr
